summary: Newton Golf filed an 8-K to report a $200,000 additional closing under an existing securities purchase agreement for convertible notes and warrants, part of a $3M facility. Terms include 10% PIK interest, 18-month maturity, conversion at $1.60/share, warrants at $1.75/share for up to 300k shares. No board recommendation or advisor named. Mechanics involve periodic closings with remaining $750k in notes and 75k warrants authorized. Watch for potential dilution if converted and use of proceeds.
